description.value: Uncle Tetsu's is a Japanese cheesecake chain originating in Fukuoka, Japan, with a Vancouver location on busy Robson Street. The shop bakes everything fresh in an open-concept kitchen using locally sourced ingredients, producing their signature soft and fluffy Japanese cheesecakes, honey madeleines, and triple-baked cheese tarts. It is a well-known destination on one of Vancouver's main urban cycling corridors.
